cardUri.description: URI of the card that was advanced when triggerSource is card_advance

createdAt.description: When the progress record was created

sessionId.description: Session ID when this progress was recorded (for linking with log records)

sessionUri.description: URI of the session record when this progress was recorded

previousLevel.description: Previous level before this update (for tracking level progression)

triggerSource.description: What action triggered this progress save

xpToNextLevel.description: Experience points needed to reach the next level

currentStamina.description: Current stamina level when this progress was recorded (decimal string, e.g. '85.5')

relatedLogUris.description: URIs of related game log records that contributed to this progress

progressPercentage.description: Progress percentage to the next level (decimal string, e.g. '75.5')

xpGainedSinceLastSave.description: Experience points gained since the last progress save

main.description: Record representing a player's level progression and game statistics

lastPostReadDate.description: Date when posts read today was last updated (for daily reset tracking)

platform.description: Platform where the level up occurred (web, mobile, etc.)

clientVersion.description: Version of the client when this progress was recorded

metadata.description: Additional metadata about this progress update
